content.short: FutureSwap is a decentralized leverage trading protocol.
content.description: FutureSwap operates on Arbitrum and Avalanche as a decentralized leverage trading protocol. Liquidity providers lock assets to earn incentives, and those locked funds are made available to traders to enable leveraged trades up to 30x. This arrangement links provider incentives with trader access, supporting margin-based trading within a decentralized framework. Developers can use the testnet to retrieve information on trades, events, liquidations, and related data.
